headline: New Zealand S&P/NZX 50 Index Rebounds 1.7% on Gainers Summerset and Delegat
summary: New Zealand's S&P/NZX 50 Index finished 1.75% higher at 13,970.38, reversing the previous session's losses behind gains in Summerset and Delegat.
why: The S&P/NZX 50 is New Zealand's primary stock index, tracking top equities listed on the NZX.

impacts.name: S&P/NZX 50
impacts.why: Broad market recovery lifted the benchmark index by 239 points.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: A rebound in major constituents like Summerset and Delegat supported a 1.75% index gain.
